requirements.paragraph_anchor: Nonblocking assignment: values in effect when the update is queued determine the right-hand value and target.
requirements.summary: A nonblocking assignment captures its right-hand value when the NBA update is scheduled.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: Integer literal constants: the apostrophe and base-format character may not be separated by white space.
requirements.summary: White space between an apostrophe and a based-literal format character is illegal.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: 2-state and 4-state data types: X and Z bits convert to zero during automatic conversion to a 2-state value.
requirements.summary: Automatic conversion from a four-state value maps each X or Z bit to zero.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: Packed structures: the first declared member is most significant and later members decrease in significance.
requirements.summary: The first member of a packed structure occupies its most-significant bits.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: Expression bit lengths: addition uses the largest operand width, including an assignment left-hand side.
requirements.summary: An assignment context propagates its width into addition operands before the addition is evaluated.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: Conditional if-else: a predicate with value X or Z is false and selects the else branch when present.
requirements.summary: An all-X conditional predicate is false and does not execute the then branch.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: Unique-if: without an explicit else, a unique if issues a violation report when no condition matches.
requirements.summary: A unique-if chain with no true condition and no else produces a violation diagnostic.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: Subroutine calls: return copies output and inout formal values back to the corresponding actual variables.
requirements.summary: A subroutine output is copied to its actual when the subroutine returns, using assignment conversion.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: Include directive: only white space or a comment may follow the directive on its line.
requirements.summary: A block comment may follow an include directive on the same source line.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: Module instances: positional and named connections may not be mixed in one instance.
requirements.summary: All port connections for one module instance are either positional or named.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: Package references: compiling a package precedes importing scopes, and import makes identifiers directly visible.
requirements.summary: A declaration imported from an earlier package source is directly visible in the importing module.

requirements.paragraph_anchor: Conditional generate: at most one constant-selected branch is instantiated into the elaborated model.
requirements.summary: Declarations and instances in an unselected conditional-generate branch are not instantiated.
